Reference image for the [[Anagrams]] row on [[Brangus Glee]], whose title is an anagram of Snuggle Bear: Snuggle Bear, the mascot of Lever Brothers' Snuggle fabric softener, above the word "Snuggle" in a 1985 TV commercial. The commercial ends with "© 1982, 1983 Lever Brothers Company".

Source: a frame at 0:06 of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GFxZ9eQwPgo 1985 *New* Snuggle Fabric Softener TV Commercial], uploaded by ewjxn to YouTube (6 January 2018). The uploader says it aired on 4 April 1985, during ''General Hospital'' on KVIA Channel 7, El Paso, Texas. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027173902/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GFxZ9eQwPgo Internet Archive], 27 October 2026. Full 480 by 360 frame. SHA-256 of the uploaded file: 9e4d99353e15320f27233f947ce7fe105928af64596a643a22ff1aff55bbfd06.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a single low-resolution frame from a 1985 Snuggle commercial, © Lever Brothers Company (the brand now belongs to Henkel), used only to show the mascot the card title refers to, beside the card on [[Anagrams]], on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the commercial or harm any market for it, and no free image of Snuggle Bear exists.
